leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Identify components that trigger unnecessary re-renders in Vue applications
Apply computed properties to optimize reactive data transformations
Implement watchers to control side effects and prevent redundant updates
Configure component lifecycle hooks to manage rendering behavior
Manipulate reactive data structures to minimize cascading re-renders
Bind event handlers efficiently to avoid performance bottlenecks
Construct memoized functions to cache expensive calculations
